titulo: The designer cousin and his concept
hooks: I asked my designer cousin for a website
Does your website have a concept, or customers?
When the designer goes full artist

mensajes.texto: Hey cuz, how's the website coming?
Sending you an idea. Don't freak out
Black on black. It's a concept
And how do you read it?
You don't read it. You feel it
Exactly. We have to break the mold
It's there. Hidden in the logo

contenido.remate: Still no website. But I've got a concept.

captions: A website can be good-looking and sell, or it can be a work of art nobody gets. Your customers are looking for your phone number, your hours and whether you have what they need.
Premium design shows when your customer finds everything without thinking: what you sell, where you are and how to reach you.
Your website has to win over your customers before your cousin. If the guy selling fridge parts needs a concept, make it one people can read.
